map.Transformer 参数量估算器，输入层数、维度等估算主体与嵌入参数量，用于: A Transformer parameter-count estimator: enter layers and dimensions to estimate body and embedding parameters, for model-scale assessment and VRAM prediction.
map.主体参数 ≈ 12·L·d²；嵌入参数 ≈ vocab × d: Body parameters ≈ 12·L·d²; embedding parameters ≈ vocab × d
map.每层含 Q/K/V/O 四个 d×d 矩阵（4d²）与两层 FFN（通常 4d: Each layer has four d×d matrices for Q/K/V/O (4d²) plus a two-layer FFN (usually 4d wide, 8d²), totalling 12d², multiplied by layers L for the body; vocabulary embedding adds vocab×d separately (if untied, the output layer adds another copy). Real models also have small parameters like LayerNorm, so the estimate is slightly low.
map.标准 Transformer 每层参数量≈12·L·d²(L 层数、d 模型维度: A standard Transformer has about 12·L·d² parameters (L layers, d model dimension), including self-attention and FFN.
map.token 嵌入≈V·d(V 词表大小)，位置编码若可学习再加 d 或 V·d。: Token embedding≈V·d (V vocabulary size); learnable positional encoding adds d or V·d.
map.总参数量用于显存与算力预算，是模型规模评估的核心指标。: Total parameters feed VRAM and compute budgets and are the core metric for model-scale assessment.
map.：L=12, d=768, V=50000：每层≈12×768²≈7.08M，1: : L=12, d=768, V=50000: each layer≈12×768²≈7.08M, 12 layers≈85M; embedding 50000×768≈38.4M; total≈123M (typical BERT-base scale).
map.为什么 FFN 占参数最多？: Why does the FFN hold the most parameters?
map.标准 FFN 内部维度常 4d，其两层权重约 8d²，而注意力 Q/K/V/O: A standard FFN has inner dimension 4d, so its two weight layers total about 8d², while attention Q/K/V/O total 4d²; so the FFN is about two thirds of each layer's parameters, which is also the focus of large-model compression.
map.词表越大参数越多吗？: Does a larger vocabulary mean more parameters?
map.是。嵌入层≈V·d 随词表线性增长；为控参数量常用子词分词限制 V，或用因子分解: Yes. Embedding≈V·d grows linearly with vocabulary; to control parameters one often uses subword tokenization to limit V, or factorized embeddings to reduce dimension overhead.
